active_contract.owner_rule: Read-only explicit canonical-owner event observations only; observed state is an opaque owner event-state reference and ODL-06 defines no universal event progression or trigger formula.
active_contract.resolution_rule: Authorization first; reconcile only observations for the same canonical event reference. Resolve only unanimous compatible observed kind/state/profile/context tuples; unknown, incompatible and conflict remain conservative.
active_contract.advisory_rule: ODL-02..05 context is separately labeled advisory and cannot synthesize, advance or adjudicate ODL-06 events.
active_contract.visibility_rule: Hidden/private event, faction, relationship, leadership, resource, Project, advisory, profile/context, provenance and permission evidence is filtered before every derived surface; hidden cardinality is undisclosed.
active_contract.mutation_rule: No crisis/coup/split/fragmentation/recombination/recovery/succession adjudication or faction/member/relationship/reputation/leadership/resource/Project/time/owner mutation; no command/permission authority or canonical write.
active_contract.persistence_decision: No durable ODL-06 persistence or duplicate political-event/faction/relationship/succession/permission ledger; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
